verses: Oh! great is now the house of Chou. The lofty hills we climb,— Both those whose ridges far extend, And those with peaks sublime. Along the Ho we watch the flow Of its embanked stream. Where'er o'erhead the sky is spread, Me truly king men deem. The princes all, both great and small, My summons promptly own. So by this progress do I know Chou stablished on the throne.
